statements: <HOME>\cache is derived/rebuildable and excluded from canonical core backup. <HOME>\logs is diagnostic, not Audit truth, excluded from core backup by default; no new duration is frozen and inherited bounded diagnostics remain binding. %TEMP%\TW-Market\<installation-id>\runtime holds ephemeral PID/ownership; its temp sibling holds unfinished acquisition/scratch/atomic-operation temporary material. Neither is portable backup content. Installation ID does not replace L1 PID/start-token/executable checks. Existing L2 bounded sibling staging/atomic finalization remains unchanged. No new multi-process/concurrency policy is invented.
